source.stem: The diagram shows a right-angled triangle.

hinge.title: Connect triangular-number dot patterns to square-number dot patterns.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: Square number is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Connect triangular-number dot patterns to square-number dot patterns' is answered as square number rather than triangular number.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Square number is what produces triangular number, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Connect triangular-number dot patterns to square-number.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The answer is triangular number because of the most obvious label, colour, size or printed number in the stem, without using 'Connect triangular-number dot patterns to square-number dot patterns' as the operative test.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: triangular number is settled by running 'Decide which locker numbers are touched exactly twice': A locker is touched exactly twice when its number has exactly two factors, 1 and itself — on the item about Connect triangular-number dot patterns to square-number.

intelligence.enrichment: A square dot array can be viewed as two adjacent triangular-number parts, so extending the triangular pattern also extends the related square pattern.
